title: Do it n times
concept: Repeat a block a fixed number of times with for and range

steps.say: The robot needs 7 gems on its own cell.
Seven `put()` lines would work. That's a lot of typing.
steps.code:
put()
put()
put()
put()
put()
put()
put()

steps.say: `for` repeats the indented lines. `range(7)` means 7 times.
How many gems will be on the cell?
Change 7 to 3: the same loop, a different count.
Start a loop that runs 5 times, with `put()` indented under it.
Indent `move()` too. Indentation decides what repeats.
Run it and watch the row fill.

recap.say: `for i in range(n):` repeats the indented block n times.
